methodologyNotes: Roster covers twelve stud finders spanning simple magnetic-only pocket tools (C.H. Hanson 03040), edge-only and center-finding electronic scanners (Zircon, Franklin Sensors, Klein, Tavool, budget imports), and professional multi-mode / radar wall scanners (Bosch GMS 120, Bosch D-tect 120, Walabot DIY 2), verified 2026-08-05 primarily against manufacturer product pages (Franklin Sensors, Zircon, Bosch Professional, Klein Tools, Walabot) and their hosted manuals, corroborated by retailer and distributor listings (Ace Hardware, Home Depot via search index, Haus of Tools, Burns Tools, Pro Supply Center, Global Test Supply, ntouchinternational, ManualsLib, electricstudfinder.com) where manufacturer sites did not publish consumer pricing or where direct fetch was blocked (403) and search-engine-cached snippets or a secondary retailer fetch were used instead. Two adversarial corrections were made to the seed list: (1) "Klein Tools ESF250" does not exist as a product in Klein's current or archived catalog (confirmed models are ESF100, ESF150LL, and ESF200); the seed was replaced with Klein's actual current Multi-Scan Center and Edge Stud Finder, ESF200 (kleintools.com, corroborated by Haus of Tools and Acme Tools). (2) "Vivreal 5-in-1" does not exist; Vivreal's actual product line is a 4-in-1 stud/metal/AC scanner sold under model TH240 (and near-identical rebadged SKUs B09TW2FN3X/B07Q5Y9Z5J/B07B9VKWSL) — the seed was replaced with the real Vivreal TH240 4-in-1 Stud Finder. "Precision Sensors ProFinder 5000" is sold under the exact name "ProFinder 5000+" (with the plus); the entry is kept under that corrected name. accessedAt 2026-08-05 throughout. Some manufacturer pages (Bosch, homedepot.com, ibspot.com, metersensorsi.com) blocked direct fetch (403/404/DNS) or omitted price; in those cases a secondary authorized-dealer/distributor listing was used for priceUsd and is noted in priceNote rather than a price being guessed.
